question: Where is the respiratory pigment in human body present?

options.text: In both plasma and white blood cells

solution:
The correct answer is __**In red blood cells.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** respiratory pigment** in the human body is** hemoglobin,** which is a **protein **found in the **red blood cells.**
 
• Hemoglobin is responsible for **carrying oxygen **from the lungs to the different parts of the body and also helps in** transporting carbon dioxide** from the** tissues to the lungs** for exhalation.
 
• The red color of the blood is due to the** presence of hemoglobin** in the red blood cells.
 
• The concentration of hemoglobin in the blood can affect the **oxygen-carrying capacity **of the blood, and any **abnormality in the hemoglobin levels** can lead to various health conditions like **anemia, sickle cell disease, **etc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **White blood cells,** also known as** leukocytes**, are responsible for the** immune response** in the body.

 
 
• They travel throughout the **bloodstream**, initiating **cellular and inflammatory reactions** to infections or wounds.
 
 
 
• **Plasma** is the liquid component of the blood that carries various **nutrients, hormones, and waste products.**
 
 
• **​Water and salts **that are absorbed through the** digestive tract** combine to make plasma.
